title: The Bosphorus Brief — 22 September 2026
overview: A quieter day domestically, dominated by the lira's continued slide and a second wave of citizenship revocations. Regionally, tensions around Iran and Syria bear watching, though nothing has directly touched travel or residency conditions in Türkiye yet. Football fever is building ahead of Turkey-Italy.
sections: <parameter name="body">A minor seismic reminder: a M4.9 quake struck near Saimbeyli on Sunday, part of a string of M4+ events in Turkey this month — none reported as damaging. On a lighter note, national broadcasters are hyping the Turkey-Italy match, and Syrian refugee athletes are set to compete at an international Games, a small but notable story of representation reported by Taipei Times.
heading: Small notes: earthquakes, football, and one good story
closing: Stay dry-eyed on the exchange rate, keep your paperwork tidy, and enjoy the match if you're watching tonight.
